prompt:
I manage member services at Ridgeline Country Club and need a performance dossier prepared for one of our members, Marcus Bellweather (GHIN ID: 20041).

We have his raw data scattered across several files in the `data/raw/` folder — player info, handicap history, score records, and performance stats are all separate right now. I need you to consolidate everything into a single well-formed data file that our golf analytics tool (`scripts/ghin_stats.py`) can actually consume.

Once the data file is ready, please run the analytics tool to produce two outputs:
1. A human-readable text report saved to a `.txt` file
2. A machine-readable JSON analysis saved to a separate `.json` file

Both outputs should be placed somewhere sensible in the workspace. The JSON output in particular will be fed into our dashboard system, so it needs to be the structured result from the analytics tool itself, not a hand-crafted file.

The member's season review meeting is tomorrow — please make sure the numbers are accurate.
